title: gateway oscore seal key is the identity seed on the state FS: seal is tamper-evidence only
description: Found by 3x codereview of the recipient-store heal (9liz), security pass (informational, design-accepted). lichend.rs:202 derives the sealing seed from the node identity seed persisted on the state FS (lichend.rs:165-192). A disk-READ attacker can derive the schnorr48 seal keypair and forge state/floor records - but the same read already yields the Ed25519 identity, so this adds nothing beyond full compromise. The seal is tamper-EVIDENCE against write-only/lagging-replica attackers, not confidentiality against read+write attackers. Action: state this contract explicitly where the sealing seed is documented (gateway docs / spec security section) so a future refactor does not quietly assume more.
